The '''battle''' of [[Obredaan system/Legends|Obredaan]] was the penultimate engagement fought between the forces of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] during the [[Orinda campaign]]. The New Republic won the battle.
